entities.summary: Felizardo Silvestre Bumba Ambrósio, nicknamed "Miller", is an Angolan basketball power forward. He is 6 ft 7 in (2.01 m) in height and 97 kg in weight. He won a gold medal with the Angola national basketball team at the 2007 African Championship. Ambrosio also played in the 2008 Summer Olympics.
